description: Caller undergoing severe opioid withdrawal symptoms with unstable housing and intense physical distress.

synthetic_dialogue.speaker: caller
synthetic_dialogue.text: Mujhe bohot tezz shareer me dard ho raha hai, do din se kuch nahi liya. Ghar waalon ne nikaal diya hai, mujhe samajh nahi aa raha main kahan jaun.

synthetic_dialogue.speaker: agent
synthetic_dialogue.text: Aap bilkul mat ghabraiye, hum aapke saath hain. Main abhi aapko medical detoxification aur aashray sthal ke liye medical team se connect kar raha hoon. Kripya line par bane rahein.
